title: 茂凯·树苗小课堂
description: 树精茂凯保留粗大树臂和青绿叶冠，低头用小壶给圆润树苗伙伴浇水。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Maokai is a massive living tree with a broad expressive bark face, an asymmetrical oversized wooden arm, heavy rootlike legs, and tufts of green leaves. Preserve his twisted trunk silhouette while using friendly rounded facial grooves and warm wood textures, without horror. Small sapling companions appear as simple cheerful leafy wooden creatures with clearly separated little roots and no sharp threatening mouths.
art_direction.scene: He stands in a bright garden corner and tips a small watering can toward a pot where one sapling companion stretches its leaves. Another tiny sapling watches from a low stone. His huge wooden hand is gentle around the can, and a pale fence with two flowers makes the scene simple, warm, and readable.
art_direction.palette: warm bark brown, moss green, mint leaf, sunny cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
